operations.name: get_customer_relationship_form_script

return_shapes.activation: On an existing saved deal, read the customer-management integration enabled flag. Add the following actions only when enabled.

actions.name: create_quotation
actions.success: Open the returned quotation resource address in a new browsing context.
actions.failure: If no resource address is returned, show a quotation-creation error. If the service returns an error message, display its first message; otherwise display the quotation-creation failure explanation.

actions.name: view_customer
actions.availability: Resolve the customer resource address for the deal; add the action only when a nonempty address exists.
actions.success: Open the customer resource address in a new browsing context.
actions.failure: Display the first supplied service error message, or a customer-link lookup failure explanation.

return_shapes.new_record_policy: No integration action setup occurs while the deal is a new unsaved record.
